description: This file defines the LogNode interface, representing a logging component that outputs log data to one or more targets. It provides a method 'println' for outputting log entries with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable data.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that outputs log messages to targets, optionally chaining to subsequent nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception to the log target.
